title: Subsystem Examples
text: Group blocks to create model hierarchy, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Function packaging} sets Code format Auto; {Read/Write permissions} sets the levels of access to contents of subsystem, {Name of error callback function} sets the name of function to be called if error occurs no, {Permit hierarchical resolution} sets the resolution for workspace variable names, {Treat as atomic unit} sets the option to execute subsystem as one unit, {Show subsystem reinitialize ports} sets the option to display reinitialize event ports, {Minimize algebraic loop occurrences} sets the option to eliminate artificial algebraic, {Schedule as} sets the type of scheduling, {Partition name} sets the name of partition, {Sample time} sets the time interval, {Treat as grouped when propagating variant conditions} sets the option to treat subsystem as unit when propagating variant, {Function name options} sets how to name generated function, {Function name} sets the name of function for subsystem code no, {File name options} sets how to name generated file, {File name (no extension)} sets the name of generated file, {Function interface} sets how to use arguments with generated function, {Function with separate data} controls code generation for subsystem, {Memory section for initialize/terminate functions} sets how to apply memory sections Inherit, {Memory section for execution functions} sets how to apply memory sections Inherit, {Memory section for constants} sets how to apply memory sections Inherit, {Memory section for internal data} sets how to apply memory sections Inherit, {Memory section for parameters} sets how to apply memory sections Inherit and {Subsystem file name} sets the filename of referenced subsystem no. Values come from the instance.
